samples.name: effect-campfire-flames-frame-1
samples.prompt: ONE transparent pixel-art campfire flame animation frame 1 of four: central tongue upright. Red outer silhouette, orange middle, pale yellow core. NO logs, stones, smoke, sparks, ground or shadow. Match tiny simple flat pixel-art style of reference Tiny Town and Tiny Farm. Intended 16x16 logical pixel square, flame about 10 pixels tall, bottom center base on bottom row, same base width 8 pixels. Top 6 rows empty transparent. Uniform large square pixel blocks, only three flat colors. No gradients, glow, edge fringe, texture, text. Full flame visible.
